ANSWER: NO

HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects the information contained in the source document. All key financial terms mentioned in the memo are either directly supported by the source document or appropriately marked as "N/A" when not disclosed in the amendment. Specifically:

- The effective date (June 27, 2023) is correct
- The borrower name (Greystone Housing Impact Investors LP, formerly America First Multifamily Investors, L.P.) is accurate
- The lender name (Bankers Trust Company) is correct
- The pledged account number (#164283-000) is accurate
- The securities intermediary (Wilmington Trust, National Association) is correct
- The dates of the original agreement (August 23, 2021) and prior amendments (April 29, 2022 and July 29, 2022) are accurate
- The memo appropriately indicates "N/A" for terms not disclosed in this amendment (deal size, interest rate, maturity date, etc.)
- The representation about no defaults occurring is accurately cited from Section IV of the source document

The memo does not fabricate or hallucinate any key financial terms that are not present in the source document.

ANSWER: NO
MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo appropriately captures all the key financial terms that are actually present in the source document. The source document is purely an administrative amendment that only modifies two definitions (Pledged Account and Securities Intermediary) and does not contain any core financial terms like interest rates, loan amounts, maturity dates, or covenant terms. 

The memo correctly identifies this limitation by noting that "Core deal terms are not modified or disclosed in this amendment and would be contained in the underlying amended and restated credit agreement dated August 23, 2021." All material information from the amendment is captured, including:

- The parties (Greystone Housing Impact Investors LP and Bankers Trust Company)
- The effective date (June 27, 2023)
- The nature of changes (administrative modifications to account definitions)
- Security details (Pledged Account #164283-000 and Wilmington Trust as Securities Intermediary)
- Borrower representations regarding no defaults

The "N/A" entries in the key deal terms table are appropriate since these terms are not addressed in this administrative amendment.
